# Residual-alpha momentum — Phase 0 IC scorecard

*Generated by `scripts/residual_alpha_phase0.py` (research/RESIDUAL_ALPHA_MOMENTUM.md). The gate: residual momentum must rank winners (IC>0, survive BH-FDR) AND beat plain total-return momentum. Betas are causal (lagged 1d); sector orthogonalized to market. Judge survivors vs ~0.*

---

**How to read.** `mom_res` vs `mom_tot` is the core test — if stripping beta doesn't raise IC/Sharpe, residual momentum is no better than plain momentum *here*. `ir_res` is the consistency-scaled headline. `rev_st` should show a **negative** IC (short-term reversal) — if so, the short timeframes are a contrarian/timing signal, not a winner picker. `|SN` = sector-neutral (within-GICS) — the 'winners within a sector' view. The broad panel is only ~3yr (thin IC-IR t-stat); the deep panel adds rebalances at the cost of a survivorship-biased 110-name cross-section. Concordance across both = a real GO.
